title: [Research] Exact selected BIT same-family ADD route invoice
body:
## Result

This package replaces the symbolic chart-route terms in PR #2195's restricted-fibre ADD formula with the exact selected GL64 route words for the complete same-family ADD subset in the pinned PR589 word.

- 288 selected local calls and 11,072 same-family ADD events.
- 33,216 ordered route actions across 43 used route types.
- Exact route primitive totals: 19,398,656 ordinary operations; 3,407,872 double-half operations; 417,792 negations; 4,177,920 controlled shifts; 1,097,728 constant shifts; 321,408 low permutations.
- Includes all 288 per-call receipts, the concrete family-451 event at stage 0 / replica 0 / position 19422, and three negative controls.

The scan-sharing screen finds 3,456 (call, family) groups, which gives a naive ceiling of 7,616 fewer selection scans. It does not count this as a saving: family 451's first and second same-family ADDs are separated by an operation that changes role 243, and the exact three-operation control shows the reorder changes role 244 on a dirty input.

## Scope

This is a partial conditional cost result, not a complete low-class invocation or a new supplier. Whole-family selection, payload XOR, fixed-tape parking, descriptor installation, precision, recursive child execution, and restoration remain unpriced. No new kappa is claimed; the selected conditional kappa is unchanged.

The route records are the 43 used records captured from PR #2157 head `eb1bf93950e9b14f7fadca7892866e9f29a26ad3`. The verifier replays each rational route word and checks it against the selected support completion and the exact bill. PR #2195 head `3a1cf78a1ba6322129e42d80c50d21765524d612` supplies the owner layout and the three-route procedure. PR #2171's preparation costs and PR #2188's descriptor work remain separate.

Assignment: seed `96e4cc54f6b42661a96b916ab0d83929`, track `recursive-interfaces`, task `selected-stock-envelope` with changed scope, base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4, selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`. Claim and handoff: [Discussion #2179](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2179#discussioncomment-18936389).

## Verification

Observed locally on CPython 3.14.7:

```text
PASS_SELECTED_BIT_ADD_ROUTE_INVOICE adds=11072 routes=33216 types=43 ordinary=19398656 groups=3456 controls=3 no_new_kappa
PASS_SELECTED_BIT_ADD_ROUTE_INVOICE adds=11072 routes=33216 types=43 ordinary=19398656 groups=3456 controls=3 no_new_kappa
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
```

The first two lines are normal and optimized verifier runs. Python 3.12 is unavailable in this environment, so the registered Python 3.12 replay was not run locally. `OVERLAP.json` records the final refresh at 00:04 UTC: 449 open PRs and 904 Discussions, complete pagination, no warnings, and no exact matches.
